headline: Dubai Islamic Bank Agrees to Acquire Emirates Islamic to Form Dh585bn Entity
summary: Dubai Islamic Bank is set to acquire Emirates Islamic, creating a combined Sharia-compliant banking institution with Dh585 billion in assets and cementing its position as the UAE's largest Islamic bank.
why: Dubai Islamic Bank is a leading financial institution in the United Arab Emirates, specializing in Islamic banking services.

impacts.name: Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC
impacts.why: Dubai Islamic Bank will acquire Emirates Islamic to form a Dh585 billion Islamic banking giant.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The consolidation creates the UAE's largest Sharia-compliant bank by assets, expanding market share.
